reason: Remove obsolete and competing result narratives from active project context after metric unification.

active_result_contract.quality_review_policy: Quality review is treated as human-quality judgment without tool-source distinction.

archive_groups.root_docs: Initial proposals, phased plans, old summaries, presentation, title discussion, and conversation export.
archive_groups.experiment_docs: Chronological progress notes, historical phase reports, and the superseded strict-30 paper narrative.
archive_groups.derived_experiment_docs: Markdown reports from the strict-30 branch and the superseded quality-risk audit; numeric artifacts remain in their original experiment directories.
archive_groups.paper_strict30_draft: Superseded paper draft whose headline result was the 30-paragraph strict branch.
archive_groups.scripts: Script that regenerates the obsolete pre-Plan-E root-level experiment summary.
archive_groups.historical_branch_scripts: Generators and analyzers tied to the superseded strict-30 paper branch; preserved for reproducibility but removed from the active script surface.

preservation.experiment_data: Original experiment directories, JSON, CSV, NPY, figures, and analysis scripts remain in place.
preservation.git_history: All moved files remain recoverable through Git history.
